content.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ casting director set for Scad Savannah Film Festival honor - IMDb
content.text: ‘One Battle After Another’ casting director set for Scad Savannah Film Festival honorCassandra Kulukundis, the frequent collaborator of Paul Thomas Anderson and casting director of One Battle After Another, is set to receive the first-ever Outstanding Achievement in Casting Award at the upcoming Scad Savannah Film Festival.The award will be presented at a screening One Battle After Another on Oct. 26, which will include a conversation with Kulukundis moderated by Gold Derby editor-in-chief Debra Birnbaum.Kulukundis has worked with Anderson on eight of his films. In addition to casting Licorice Pizza, Phantom Thread, Inherent Vice, The Master, There Will Be Blood, Punch-Drunk Love, and Magnolia, she has worked on major movies including The Brutalist, Her, Ghost World, and Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle.See full article at Gold Derby10/10/2025by Kevin P.
